arStrings.szText: Oh, what a time the Vecin showed me. Singing by the cookfire, tales of magic beneath the stars...but a grave silence awaited us in Wejinhani.

The Zakarum Inquisition has descended upon this land. And the arrival of a haggard, western scholar has raised eyebrows. I had best move on before I complicate matters for my new friends, though my heart aches to do so.
(sighs) I need to think. Somewhere quiet and alone, where I can decide what I am still doing on this misadventure. Perhaps North?
